text: [Music] Hi, I'm Fun from Local Vietnam and I'm going to tell you what to expect from this 7-day trip to San Vietnam. Before I tell you all about this trip, I'll first briefly explain who we are. Local Vietnam is a half Western and half Vietnamese travel agency. We really are local. Our whole team is based in Vietnam and we are also fully specialized in Vietnam. Therefore, what we can offer you is that we can fully customize this tour to your wishes. Whether you have specific hotel needs, want to extend or shorten your trip, a different destination or tour, anything is possible. And we don't charge extra for changes. Another advantage of our local presence is that you have direct contact with us during your trip. In Hanoi, you will meet someone from local Vietnam and we give a free SIM card with this tour so you can keep in touch via WhatsApp anytime, anywhere. We are in the same time zone and because we arrange everything ourselves without intermediaries, we can solve any problems ourselves and answer and adjust any questions or changes during your trip immediately. Now, let's dive a little deeper into this round trip. The trip is designed for travelers who want to focus specifically on central Vietnam and take in as many highlights of this region as possible. This tour of central Vietnam is best done in the spring and summer period when it is perfect for beautiful beach days. Autumn and winter bring more rain, but the weather becomes lovely from February onwards, especially in the months of October and November. This tour is not recommended. From February, the weather again starts to get really great. This tour lets you see a lot in the time you have in Vietnam. It offers you a wealth of impressions and you make the most of your days. But if possible, I recommend adding an extra day or 2 days or even more to this trip. For example, you can take an extra day of rest at the beach, explore a town, or enjoy stunning mountain views. We can advise you exactly where best to plan your extra days. I'm going to show you the entire trip now. And again, remember that we can feel everything about this trip. Welcome to Hoan. Hoan is a small historic town in central Vietnam because of its beautiful historic downtown. It is also called the most beautiful city in Vietnam and is on the UNESCO World Heritage list. The town is full of picturesque historical houses, temples, tailor, and cafes. And in the evening in the town beautifully lit with lanterns, and you can go shopping at the night market. Just outside the city, you will find traditional rural life with rice patties, fishing villages, water buffaloos, and you name it. A great area to explore by bicycle. In addition, Hoyan also has relaxing beaches to unwind on this Vietnam trip. Therefore, this is a place where we would like to let you enjoy a little longer and also give you more time to make your own planning. Because whether you want to explore a lovely town, go on bicycle through the countryside, or have a relaxing day at the beach, there is something for everyone. With a guided bicycle tour through the countryside of Hoan, you can experience the more authentic Vietnamese life. There are plenty of photo opportunities with rice fields, water buffaloos, craft villages, and the river. Depending on your wishes, we can customize the bike tour with additional activities, including a trip in a basket boat through the coconut mangrove or actively participate in working on the land to get vegetables or participate in a Vietnamese cooking class. Depending on what you choose, it often takes half a day, so you can spend the other half of the day exploring the old town on your own or relaxing on Hoyan's beach. Not far from Hoyan, you will find the largest Cham temple complex in existence, Misan. In this round trip, you will visit this temple complex in a half-day trip along with some fun other activities. You get time to explore the temples which by the way are located in the beautiful jungle. You will learn more about the ancient civilization and the effects of the Vietnam War on this complex. After this visit, you will go to someone's home and see how they make rice paper the traditional way. The last part back to Hoyan you will do by boat. Sail down the Thubon River and witness the life of fishermen and local people. The road between Huan and Gray where you find the hyphen pass is considered one of the most beautiful routes in Vietnam. It was made famous in the British car show Top Gear where they rode this route with scooters and called the Hiban Pass, one of the most beautiful coastal roads in the world. That's why in this round trip, we don't just take you from A to B. You do it by sightseeing transfer. You will go by car with private driver. But if like the gentleman of Top Gear, you want to do it by motorcycle, we can also offer you an easy rider tour where you do this route on the back of a motorbike with experienced riders. We also have the option of doing this route by old and open military jeep. On this route, you will visit the marble mountains. In these limestone mountains, you will find caves with hidden temples. Take your time to discover them. You'll also make a visit to Laan Lagoon for a more authentic look at Vietnamese fishing life and the beautiful beach of Lanc. But the highlight is the beautiful Hyan Pass route. Along the way, you'll stop frequently to enjoy the views. And since this is a private ride, you'll be able to stop anywhere you want to soak in the views or take a photo. Qu is the ancient capital of Vietnam with dozens of temples, tombs, and palaces, some of which are hundreds of years old. In this city, you will tour some of the most unique sites. The most famous place you will visit with a local guide is the Imperial Citadel with magnificent gates, palaces, and temples. You will then also visit the most impressive tombs, and you will enjoy a peaceful boat ride on the Perfume River on a dragon boat. In a one-day tour, you will visit the two most popular caves in the national park. Both caves are very walkable, huge inside, and have landscaped paths. So you don't have to worry if you are claustrophobic. But if you are looking for something more adventurous though, we can adapt this. The first cave is Fna Cave, named after the national park. To get to the entrance, you take a boat ride across the river. Along the way, you enjoy the real countryside, water buffalo cooling off in the river and the forests of the national park. Once at the entrance, you take a walk through the cave before returning by boat. Next, you visit Paradise Cave. Located deep in the jungle, but easily accessible by road. Paradise Cave is gigantic, huge cave rooms with unique formations of stelagmites and stagmmites. The cave is beautifully lit and there are good paths laid out. Do you have any question or would you like to customize something on this trip? Please feel free to contact us. Hope to see you in beautiful Vietnam.
